content: Isa Girapo Ee Dokona Lao Kenane Doko

content.text: Nambana mona retenge dokona suu pyaa.
Mona retenge kenane dokome banya girapo ee dokona pyao ranaisa poko pyarowale.
Nambana mona dokome banya girapo ee doko yuu mandarena
rumbyasi keyange dokona wara pipala karenge
Baame kana dupwa nyuo kakondao yuu ape ape pyao pingi.
Dopa pipala baame girapo keyange wingi dupwa wara pingi.
Baame girapo kingyaramo yuwale dupwa kyaso
dee anda kama dululi pipala isaro karara anda doko pipala
girapo poo relyape lao isaro karenge.
Dopa pipyamopape girapo peparae kau pingi aiyange dupwa lyepa piya.

content: Dokona lao Juta Jerusaleme palenge wambu nakamame namba mende pii napusa pilyape panda girapo ee baame pilyape lao soo kandapala lalapape.
Nambame piruli mende kaeyapala namba isa pupunusa pilyape? Dopa pyuo isa paa naronde ramo doko akipamo keyange lyera lao kandaro karapunu kata dokona kau pingi aiyange doko yapo lyilyape?

Nambame piru doko dapa pyuo pirunu kandalapale. Doko kame maronge dupwa lalyuo asu pinyi nembapala kame angi suwa menape kame piro karena lao piyu dupwa lalyinyi nembo mena rakaiye wii saape kame lalyuo nyuo pirunupa nao mena gulungalu lao karenale.

Ranome ando girapo anamasi minyinya laro lao dokopa pyakepanyi nembo yuu kapu kyuo pii naro. Dopa pingi kandale doko suu pyao nepereke ikyaikyape pulyinya lao piru. Namba kopa dokome apu kata mai nana lao lamairu.

content.text: Isaraele wambu dupwa Kamongo Porai Wakasana isa girapo ee mendeke ingyuo serenge.
Juta wambu dupwa girapo angi baame warapiyamo andenge dopale.
Dokome baame nakama keyange pimili lao suu piyamo dokona
palyuo pyuo kara napala wambu pungi yando nao kwaeyami.
Rolae karamili lao suu piya dokona palya napala
mendeme mendali nyuo isa palyalanako suu pyao piyaminyi dokome range mende pyao isa palyingi dokopa kote rolae lakanako lao minyuo pao karenge.

content: 5:8-30 Wambu yulu koo wakale wakale pingi dupwa keta randa epenge.
